navigation.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#f9f7f4]/80 border-b border-[#e6dfd7]/50
navigation.interaction: Brand dropdown menu using Shadcn NavigationMenu or DropdownMenu. Smooth fade-in.

buttons.primary: bg-[#1a1a1a] text-white hover:bg-[#d4af37] transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-3 rounded-none uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#1a1a1a] text-[#1a1a1a] hover:bg-[#1a1a1a] hover:text-white transition-colors duration-300 px-8 py-3 rounded-none uppercase text-xs tracking-[0.2em]

product_card.style: Minimalist. Image container with aspect-[4/5] bg-white overflow-hidden group. Text below image, left aligned.
product_card.hover: Image scales up to 1.05x smoothly. Button fades in at bottom of image.

brand_card.style: Aspect-square or 3/4 relative overflow-hidden group cursor-pointer
brand_card.text: Absolute bottom-0 left-0 p-8 text-white z-10

motion.page_load: Framer motion for staggered fade-in and slight upward translation (y: 20 to 0).
motion.hover: Image scale 1.05 with smooth transition duration-500 ease-out. No bouncy effects.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the website using pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for layout.
Use lucide-react for all icons (thin, elegant stroke width if possible).
Implement a sticky navigation with a glassmorphism effect (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#f9f7f4]/80) when scrolling. Use Radix/Shadcn UI for the brand dropdown menu.
The hero section should be cinematic, occupying 80vh to 100vh with a large image and elegant typography.
Add a trust signals row below the hero (e.g., Free Shipping, Expert Advice, Authenticity, Samples) using small, subtle icons and uppercase tiny text.
The 'Nach Maison entdecken' section should be a grid of 4 large brand cards with image backgrounds and dark overlays.
The product grid (Newest & Bestsellers) should feature high-end minimalist product cards (no visible card border/background, image focus).
Include a 'Medical Beauty Philosophy' editorial section with a 50/50 image and text split layout.
The footer should be a clean luxury footer with lots of whitespace.
Ensure generous spacing (py-24 or py-32) between sections.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
Import Playfair Display and Montserrat fonts from Google Fonts in the main HTML/CSS.
